# Dowloading requiered Packages
```{r}

# Install pacman 
if (!require("pacman")) {
  install.packages("pacman", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

# Install DESeq2 
if (!require("DESeq2")) {
  if (!require("BiocManager")) install.packages("BiocManager")
  BiocManager::install("DESeq2")
}

# Install phyloseq 
if (!require("phyloseq")) {
  if (!require("BiocManager")) install.packages("BiocManager")
  BiocManager::install("phyloseq")
}

pacman::p_load(
  knitr, data.table, ggplot2, dplyr, forcats, here, ggpubr, rstatix, 
  readxl, writexl, tidyverse, emmeans, ARTool, purrr, rlang, DHARMa, 
  lme4, car, lattice, effects, lmerTest, broom, glmmTMB, performance, 
  MASS, broom.mixed, vegan, ggrepel, openxlsx, FSA, cowplot
)

```
